def fs_replace_badchars(payload):
    """replace characters that conflict with the flowsynth syntax"""
    badchars = ['"', "'", ';', ":", " "]
    for char in badchars:
        payload = payload.replace(char, "\\x%s" % str(hex(ord(char)))[2:])
    payload = payload.replace("\r\n", '\\x0d\\x0a')
    return payload
